class.name: NNHTNCondition
class.brief_description: A Boolean expression over the HTN world state and the occurrence arguments.
class.description: Add conditions to [member NNHTNNodes.conditions]; all of a node's conditions must hold for it to be available. [member expression] is a Godot [Expression] in which board keys are variables and [code]args[/code] is the [Dictionary] of the occurrence's arguments: [codeblock] is_scared and not is_tired health < args.get("limit", 25) [/codeblock] A key that is absent from the state reads as [code]null[/code]. A board key literally named [code]args[/code] is shadowed by the arguments and cannot be read. [Array] and [Dictionary] values are deep-copied for each evaluation; [Object] values keep their identity, so expressions are trusted project code. The expression must return a [bool]. A parse error, an execution error (for example comparing an absent key with a number) or any other result is reported as an error and evaluates to [code]false[/code], so a broken condition makes its node unavailable. A parse error is reported once per expression; execution errors are reported every time. The keys an expression reads are inferred from its text (see [method get_read_keys]), so changes to them trigger replanning without being listed in [member NNHTNNodes.dependency_keys]. The parsed expression is cached and parsed again only when [member expression] changes.

method.name: evaluate
method.description: Evaluates [member expression] with the keys of [param state] and the arguments [param args]. Returns [code]false[/code] after reporting an error when the expression cannot be parsed or executed, or does not return a [bool].

method.name: get_parse_error
method.description: Returns why [member expression] does not parse, or an empty string when it parses. An empty expression does not parse.

method.name: get_read_keys
method.description: Returns the state keys [member expression] reads, in order of first use: its free identifiers, leaving out string literals, [code]args[/code], keywords such as [code]and[/code] and [code]true[/code], type names, member names after a [code].[/code] and called functions. For [code]health < args.get("limit", 25) and pos.x > 0[/code] they are [code]health[/code] and [code]pos[/code].
